reviews.x: Love this makeup organizer! Fits everything I need it to fit and is easy to carry! I haven't been able to get it to roll up as compact as it is in the picture, but I still love it! If I had one negative it would be that the clear plastic that forms the pouches is quite thin so you have to be careful when putting larger products or products with edges into the pouch.
This is deceptively small. One of the pictures shows a few bottles of shampoo fitting into it plus a ton of other stuff. No way.  Returning.

reviews.t: Very practical and useful... not that great of a quality.
reviews.x: IT IS REALLY REALLY GREAT! I could bring wherever I wanted to since is small but it fits everything you need. Very very useful. I'd definetely give this bag five starts if it wasn't for the fact that one of the zippers broke after about two months of use. I will buy it again, though. It's VERY practical and makes your life a lot easier having each 'section' of makeup organized and in its own place. I'll just try to put less products inside of it and be more careful with it. A great, practical pr

reviews.t: Great Concept - Poor Stitching at Zipper Ends
reviews.x: Love the concept. But at 1st use one of the zipper pulls came off when I unzipped the pocket.  I couldn't get the zipper pull back on. My solution was to put a small safety pin at end of the zipper so it couldn't come of the tracks.  I did that for all the zipper pockets which will allow me use it.  Definitely not for frequent use but currently I don't travel a whole lot. If manufacturer would reinforce the stitching I'd give it 5 stars.

Not great. It did the job of carrying my cosmetics for a while, but here in the last month, one of the seams starting unraveling, followed quickly by the zipper busting. I only bought it last May, so it didn't even make it one year. I didn't even use it every day, most of the time only once or twice a week, which further reflects negatively on the quality. It was a cheap buy, so I'm not too upset,  but I will not buy this bag again.

reviews.t: A bit too small for real usefulness.
reviews.x: The compartments are not as large as I had hoped.  I won't be able to use this for my toiletries, as I'd hoped.  (Yes, I know it is advertised as a make up bag, but I would need bigger pouches for my make up stuff, too.  These are all about 2" deep at most, and when zippered, it doesn't let me fit some of the larger jars that I need.)

reviews.t: This bag was smaller than i expected but still useful. Attentive seller
reviews.x: This bag is way smaller than I expected but still useful for small items such as tampons or toothpaste. Truthfully, I will probably just trash it or give it to my 8 year old after my vacation. I had originally rated 1 star but upped it to 3 because the seller was very attentive. My issue was addressed promptly.

reviews.t: I threw this in the garbage, it was so cheaply made

It's just ok. I barely have anything in it and it's already ripping. Also, I'm not able to get it to fold into a box, I guess it have to be completely packed. Right now, the only shape im getting is a large mailing envelope. It's thin.  This is ok just to use as a travel case. Not everyday use

reviews.t: Does not roll up like in picture
reviews.x: It does what it's supposed to "hold stuff" but does not roll up like it shows. Wanted it for makeup but not enough in the pouches so I tried to use toiletries and stuff it but still doesn't roll up like in the photo.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the bag practical and useful for travel, appreciating its see-through design and ability to hold makeup, though some wish it were larger.
A common complaint is that the clear plastic is very thin and cheap-feeling, with several reviewers reporting rips or tears.
Durability is a frequent concern, with multiple reviewers reporting broken zippers, unraveling seams, or the product failing within weeks to under a year.
Several reviewers note the bag does not roll up as compactly or as shown in the pictures, only folding in half.
Some reviewers found the product deceptively small and the compartments too shallow for their needs.
